title: Italian-Style Briny Shrimp Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with Italian-style briny shrimp, served with a side of garlic rice.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Transfer shrimp to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Add red pepper flakes, if using, and cook for 1 minute.
Add lemon juice and italian seasoning, and stir to combine.
Add cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the lemon-oil mixture.
Warm wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning rice mixture onto the wrap, followed by shrimp.
